hook: Add a real photo to every product - find items by sight, not just by name.
target_audience: Cashiers and shop staff working a busy counter, especially with lookalike products like food or bakery items.
problem: Cashiers wasting time squinting at a text-only product list to find the right item.
solution: Each product can carry a photo, auto-compressed client-side to a small 160px JPEG so the whole catalog still fits comfortably in browser storage.
